candidates: When annotating parameters that accept multiple types or complex dict types, use `Union` from `typing` (e.g., `Union[str, dict[Union[int, str], str]]`) rather than the `|` union syntax, since the project targets Python versions where `|` is not supported and enforces mypy type-checking.

When the same warning or error message string is used in more than one code path, extract it into a single named variable or constant (module-level or class attribute) rather than duplicating the literal string.
